name: journal
description: Journal-discipline tooling for a VardeMem-backed agent: the Journal is the append-only store VardeMem indexes, and these hooks keep it well-formed and non-empty. enforce-journal-entry (a Stop hook) blocks a session once when it did substantive work and wrote nothing to the Journal resolved from .vardemem.json, so no session feeds the memory system nothing. (The companion quality gate enforce-journal-tags and the episodic-spine preloader preload-spine arrive in the stacked follow-up PRs.) The hooks are opt-in per tenant (config under the trusted passwd/token home at <home>/.config/journal/, not derived from $HOME per #2310; $JOURNAL_CONFIG_DIR overrides), fail-open, and disable-able by name in $JOURNAL_DISABLED (the legacy $HARNESS_MANAGEMENT_DISABLED is honored). The journal path is never hardcoded; it is resolved the way vardemem resolves it (trusted walk from cwd for .vardemem.json, then $AGENT_VAULT). Version lives in the consuming marketplace, never here.
